x: A name to note in the Manchester team was R.Wilde, who was amongst the day's fastest times and with team-mate Gregory and the whole Longwood quartet , were faster than any of our four men!

Runners finishing after him read like a list of who's who in English cross country: 18.A.Holden; 19.P.Standing; 22.R.Wilde; 23.D.Bedford; 27.K.Steer.....Crabb, Cannon, Beevor, Tagg....What a great pity that we did not turn out our best side to back him up and give ourselves a more respectable team place.
